recap.analyst:
Montaña CF and Navigli United drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.41–0.03: Montaña CF did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Montaña CF had 56% of the ball. Pass completion MON 80% (152/189), NAV 78% (132/170). Shots 4–1, on target 1–1.

Montaña CF started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Navigli United in a 4-3-3 (balanced). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 50': Montaña CF levelled the match through S. Kawadate. The chance was worth xG 0.07 (about 7 in 100 go in), struck at 81 km/h. Score now MON 1-1 NAV.

By the numbers: Y. Frestrand completed the most passes (28); R. Belruda hit the top speed (32.7 km/h); L. Serchard covered the most ground (6.19 km, a 17.6 km per-90 pace); R. Belruda won the most challenges (16).

Discipline: fouls 1–2, yellows 0–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: sunny, 29°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Castellana Arena, Madrid. B. Olalagu broke the deadlock in the 38th minute. S. Kawadate struck in the 50th for Montaña CF. Montaña CF had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: B. Olalagu, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
